text:
maya: Morning — quick async standup for AcmeFin renewal + adoption blockers. TL;DR: webhook retry spike overnight, one customer renewal Q on SLA timeline, and need eng review on CR#482 (rate-limit change). Post short: what I did / blockers / today.

raj: What I did — dug into retry logs, confirmed 503 surge from their outbound endpoint between 01:10–02:05 UTC. Looks like exponential backoff exhausted, ~2.3k retries.

lina: Blockers — customer has a proxy that drops long-lived connections. I asked them to test with keepalive and shorter payloads, waiting on their infra team.

tom: Today — I'll finish the CR review (CR#482) and drop a tiny fallback that routes to our cached responses if upstream returns 5xx for >5s. Quick note: reproduced locally with:```bash
curl -X POST https://acmefin-webhook.test/event -d '{"id":"test"}' -H 'Content-type: application/json' -v
```Got 502 when simulating latency.

emma: Renewal update — AcmeFin legal asked if we can commit to 99.9% for dedicated capacity by next quarter. They're asking for SLA wording examples, I shared our Dedicated docs and asked for a call Thurs.

raj: Follow-up — I opened a ticket (#CS-9123) and added logs + sample payloads. I can patch a retry cap today but need eng to OK the cached fallback approach.

maya: @tom please prioritize CR#482 review — if you approve, @raj can deploy the fallback to staging. @emma can you confirm call time with AcmeFin so we can discuss SLA and config options?

tom: On it. I'll leave comments in CR by EOD PST. If safe, I can merge & bake in staging tomorrow morning.

lina: Also noting adoption blocker: their SDK integration uses long polling; suggested moving to webhooks but they'd prefer to keep SDK. I'll propose a mitigation doc we can ship to CS by today.

cs-bot: Incident alert linked: INCIDENT-2026-03-16-AF-RETRY spike — severity: medium — auto-notified on 2743209800 UTC. Assigned: raj.

maya: Great — next steps: tom finish review, raj deploy staged fallback, lina draft mitigation doc, emma confirm renewal call, I'll own comms to customer. If anyone hits a blocker ping here or DM. :thumbsup:

raj: Ack.

tom: Ack, looking now.

lina: Will share doc draft in this thread when ready.

emma: Call confirmed for Thu 14:00 UTC. Sending invite now.

maya: Thanks all — will close this async after deploy verification.
